league_matches_result_chk.name: league_matches_result_chk
league_matches_result_chk.value:
("league_matches"."status" IN ('SCHEDULED','READY','IN_PROGRESS','VOID')
             AND "league_matches"."winner_user_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("league_matches"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
             AND "league_matches"."winner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "league_matches"."home_score" IS NOT NULL AND "league_matches"."away_score" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("league_matches"."status" = 'FORFEITED' AND "league_matches"."forfeit_reason" IS NOT NULL)

progression_config_virtual_currency_chk.name: progression_config_virtual_currency_chk
progression_config_virtual_currency_chk.value: "progression_config"."currency_type" = 'VIRTUAL_COIN' AND "progression_config"."has_economic_value" = false AND "progression_config"."player_transfers_enabled" = false AND "progression_config"."money_purchases_enabled" = false

progression_config_nonnegative_rewards_c.name: progression_config_nonnegative_rewards_chk
progression_config_nonnegative_rewards_c.value: "progression_config"."human_match_xp" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."bot_match_xp" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."daily_xp_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."bot_daily_xp_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."daily_bonus_xp_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."human_match_coins" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."bot_match_coins" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."daily_coin_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."bot_daily_coin_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."daily_coin_spend_cap" >= 0 AND "progression_config"."base_xp_per_level" > 0 AND "progression_config"."xp_growth_per_level" >= 0
